# Clipify

> Clipify helps Twitch creators organize clips, play highlights on stream, export videos for sharing, and publish galleries and Creator Pages.

Use one browser-source URL in OBS Studio, Streamlabs, XSplit or similar software. Clip export and public sharing also work without an OBS setup. The optional Runner broadcasts from the creator's own computer; Clipify does not host the broadcast.

## Product reference

- [Full product reference](https://clipify.us/llms-full.txt): Product behavior, account contexts, security, collaboration, exports, integrations and the generated plan comparison.
- [Features](https://clipify.us/features): Exports, reusable layouts, playlists, overlays, live controls, galleries and Runner.
- [Pricing](https://clipify.us/pricing): Current Free/Pro availability, live monthly/yearly prices and promotions. Do not infer prices from old examples.
- [Help Center](https://help.clipify.us): Setup and troubleshooting.

## Creator workflows

- [Get started](https://clipify.us/login): Twitch sign-in creates or opens the creator account. An existing account can continue to a saved destination.
- [Clip exports and layouts](https://clipify.us/features#exports): Find highlights in Clip Inventory or past streams. Download Original clips or export Desktop (16:9) and Mobile (9:16) versions using saved layouts. Free composed exports have Clipify branding; Pro can remove it. Original downloads remain untouched. Download and upload files yourself; automatic social publishing is not included.
- [Playlists and OBS overlays](https://clipify.us/features#playlists): Curate reusable playlists and choose playback sources. Pro adds advanced filters, on-demand imports, Theme Studio and live controls. Runner is not required for browser-source playback.
- [Website galleries](https://clipify.us/gallery): Publish curated or live clip collections using Clipify Elements. Public website embeds and private OBS source URLs are different.
- [Community](https://clipify.us/community): Search discoverable creators in a compact grid of outlined avatars. Open a profile card for available clip counts and profile links. A Creator Page can be unlisted and remain available through its direct URL.
- [Runner](https://clipify.us/features#runner): Runner is included with Free and Pro, with unlimited streaming hours on your own computer. Free supports manual playback/live fallback on one active broadcast and destination. Pro adds scheduling, multiple destinations/broadcasts, standby customization and watermark removal.

## Accounts and access

Dashboard context follows the selected creator or agency. Without an explicit selection, a creator's own account is the default. Team membership and agency permissions do not grant unrestricted access. Invitations, custom roles, connected provider accounts, verified email, passkeys and recovery are managed through their relevant account screens. Some sensitive actions require fresh authentication.

Privacy preferences are available in Settings → Account, the public footer and the Cookie Policy. Basic cookieless traffic statistics remain active. Account-linked analytics, engagement, heatmaps and browser measurement require statistics consent; support chat uses functionality consent.

## AI assistant access (MCP)

MCP is included on Free and Pro at `https://clipify.us/mcp`. Compatible clients use OAuth with PKCE; metadata and supported scopes are discovered automatically. Users approve creators and Read, Write or Custom permissions. Write can include deletion when requested. Private OBS links and device credential rotation require their specific permissions. Creator permissions and plan limits still apply; revoke access in Settings → Connections.

The public catalog contains {{MCP_TOOL_COUNT}} tools and {{MCP_PROMPT_COUNT}} optional prompt suggestions, generated from the current registries. See the full reference for tool names and supported workflows. Exporting video files, billing, team administration and security settings are not MCP capabilities.
